dataset_title: 省道里程坐標(里程牌標誌)
crs: EPSG:4326 (WGS84) for lon/lat; EPSG:3826 (TWD97 TM2) for twd97_x/twd97_y
notes: Source file supplied by the operator: downloaded from the official data.gov.tw / 公路局 distribution in a normal browser (this container is blocked by the site WAF) and staged verbatim as raw/thb_7040_milepost.csv; SHA-256 recorded below. Original upload left unmodified.
Encoding cp950; all 23 declared source columns present and in the published order.

km_raw (起點樁號) is the as-installed chainage, so whole-kilometre signs are frequently recorded a few metres off the round value (e.g. the 台13甲 9K sign pair sits at 9K+015 / 9K+022). Resolve by 牌面內容 (sign_face), not by exact km_m equality.
1 m chainage gaps are left/right-side sign pairs at the same point (install_position 左側/右側, face_direction 順向/逆向); 中央 signs are 雙向.

32 rows carry 坐標-X/Y-TWD97 in TM2 zone 119 (EPSG:3825) instead of zone 121 (EPSG:3826); 6 further rows have an unexplained 90-320 m TWD97/WGS84 disagreement. The WGS84 columns are correct in every case. See VERIFY.json -> provincial_coordinate_consistency. Not corrected here.
